key_points: Prepare product demonstration materials in English
Bring a computer/PC to the meeting
summary: Speaker A asks to confirm the start time of tomorrow's meeting. Speaker B confirms it starts at 10 AM in the third-floor conference room. A agrees to prepare product demo materials and B requests they be in English with a PC brought along, which A agrees to send tonight.

turns.translation: What time does our meeting start tomorrow? I want to confirm the time.
Tomorrow's meeting is from 10 AM. The location is the conference room on the third floor.
Okay, then I will prepare the product demonstration materials. Do I need to bring a computer?
Yes, please bring your computer. Please prepare the materials in English.
No problem, I will send the materials to you tonight. Thank you.
